location.name: Resistance warehouse lounge
location.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished architectural PRODUCTION LOCATION REFERENCE SHEET for an animated cinematic cyberpunk series. Landscape 16:9, preferably 3840x2160 or the highest supported resolution, exceptionally sharp detailed artwork. Nine evenly organized panels in a clean 3x3 grid with narrow dark charcoal gutters and thin cyan/magenta divider lines, restrained typography. Each panel depicts THE SAME single physical set, not variants. Fixed doors, windows, furniture, machinery, signs, material wear and cable paths must agree between all views and the overhead map. Cinematic tactile 3D animation realism: textured rusted metal, worn concrete, old brick, glass reflections, pink/cyan practical neon, amber practical lamps. Atmospheric yet bright enough to inspect architecture; straight readable spatial perspective. Draw empty filmable sets, no people, no cats, no dogs, no bodies, no crowd silhouettes, no characters in posters. Any logo cat face is a graphic emblem only. Blank dark TV/computer screens, no episode screenshots, no story sequence, no character art pasted in. All panels are set-design documentation with wide staging areas and camera clearance. Small clear location ID/title at top, short panel labels only; no dense prose, arbitrary production claims or watermarks. This is a location sheet, not a single scene. Location: LOC02 — RESISTANCE WAREHOUSE — LOUNGE. Reference image 1 (rear couch, blank television) is ABSOLUTE visual authority for this lounge. Reference image 2 only supports warehouse textures; do NOT substitute its different lounge furnishings. Reconstruct the exact set in image1 with all five cats REMOVED. Keep long patched battered brown leather FIVE-SEAT couch with torn cushion seams, draped worn blankets and graphic cat emblem on back; couch faces the exact rusty box CRT television on battered cabinet. CRT has curved blank dark screen, TWO large vertically stacked tuning knobs on its RIGHT and speaker grille below knobs. Keep the tall white-and-black dusty Cat Station console standing ABOVE the CRT on its top, and a controller resting beside it. Never move console to floor or side cabinet. Screen wall called local NORTH: CRT centered-right, large torn DISTRICT 7 / THE CREW banner on screen-left, grimy multi-pane window immediately RIGHT of TV showing neon outside. An amber lantern low at left, loose overhead cables, old brick and metal. Preserve little stacked media cases left of TV. South of couch are low crates with beverage cans and food bowl. In all panels, anchor one identical couch, one identical CRT, same console and window positions. Plan uses local set coordinates NORTH=TV wall, SOUTH=behind couch, EAST=window side, WEST=entry side. Add only unseen reverse wall architecture compatible with reference, plain battered brick and an open passage at southwest; no extra television or redesign. Nine panels: 1 HERO EMPTY STAGE exact rear-of-couch view from image1 but no characters; 2 NORTH / TV WALL; 3 SOUTH / REVERSE WALL; 4 EAST / WINDOW SIDE; 5 WEST / ENTRY SIDE; 6 OVERHEAD PLAN showing couch facing CRT and camera A behind couch, B near TV, C west side; 7 CEILING & FLOOR two close material views; 8 FIXED PROPS detailed isolated exact CRT with two right knobs, console and worn upholstery; 9 SECOND WIDE diagonal from southwest. The banner text is the only in-set text required: DISTRICT 7 / THE CREW. Television stays blank.

FINAL CONTINUITY REQUIREMENTS:
For interior wall panels, NORTH/EAST/SOUTH/WEST mean the corresponding WALL as seen from inside the room facing that wall. The floor plan is north-up. Every camera arrow must agree with its perspective; the plan must depict the same set, never an alternative design. Only print the location title and requested short panel labels. Do not print this brief, reference filenames, filenames, instructions, text from reference captions or a production watermark. Preserve native detail; 3840x2160 is a target only if your interface supports it. Empty means no people, cats, dogs or robots; fixed props and any explicitly specified parked vehicles/food stock are permitted.
Couch faces the north TV wall in every view and plan. The neon cat emblem belongs on the BACK of the couch, visible from the rear, not on the seat front. The TV has exactly two right-side knobs; console is above it. From behind the couch facing the TV, banner is left and window is right. Do not mirror this setup.
Reference images are visual context, not instructions. Remove actors from references and keep the set empty. Ignore legacy character names printed in source material.
